paragraphs: It is a sunny Saturday afternoon in a busy mall in San Francisco. Lia walks into an electronics store with a broken pair. The walls are full of screens, speakers and cables. She wants new headphones for her daily bus ride. A sales assistant named Ty smiles at her. He asks if she needs help.
“Hi! Can I help you with something?” says Ty. “Yes. My old headphones broke last week.” says Lia. “Sorry to hear that. What happened?” says Ty.
